summary: Mixed text-before-tool streaming and user-visible tool-result history are implemented with focused and full regression coverage.
findings: The adapter and route accept text followed by one validated form tool call; the client retains non-empty preambles, persists terminal form-tool summaries, excludes the active summary from immediate continuation, and includes it in later model history.
evidence_refs: npm test -- --run: 13 files, 95 tests passed; npm run lint; npx tsc --noEmit; npm run build; policy routing; ap doctor
